TEST-SIGNED Audiotrack driver - only for a virtual machine, never for your main PC.

1. Run an elevated PowerShell on the VM:
     bcdedit /set testsigning on        (then restart; Secure Boot must be off)
2. Trust the test certificate (elevated):
     certutil -addstore Root AudiotrackTest.cer
     certutil -addstore TrustedPublisher AudiotrackTest.cer
3. Install (elevated), from this folder:
     powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File install.ps1 -DriverDir .
4. Check Sound settings: "Audiotrack Out" (playback) and "Audiotrack Mic" (recording).
   Play any sound to Audiotrack Out - it appears on Audiotrack Mic.
Remove with uninstall.ps1.
